propositions: The enrich drain gate check (pending_enrichment) runs O(tickets) for every write, costing 490-740 ms against a 20 ms budget, due to issuing ~24000 filesystem metadata syscalls per probe.
The gate fires on 100% of writes (not just soaked stores), rendering its budget-breach warning useless as a real signal and adding 0.6-0.8 s pure overhead to every ticket write.

Under concurrent write load (multiple agents), gate checks contend on kernel vnode cache saturation rather than CPU, producing 4-6x latency amplification as walkers serialize on shared filesystem metadata state.

The fix introduces an O(1) marker (.rebar/enrich-gate.json) recording next_eligible_ns; pending_enrichment returns [] immediately when the marker proves the store quiet, otherwise runs the full scan once and recomputes the marker.
The marker is invalidated on every queue mutation (_append), self-heals via TTL expiry (10 minutes), and degrades to full scan on any marker corruption or absence, never suppressing real work.
